integrity: Every weakly acyclic automaton can be topologically relabeled so that both transition maps are nondecreasing. The verifier exhausts all 720 maps per letter in this representation, computes exact subset-automaton distances, independently replays equality cases, and checks the full symmetry orbit.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exhaustive six-state binary classification for distinguished three-element subsets. It does not determine the general weakly acyclic subset-synchronization extremal function, and an unindexed prior computation could contain the same finite census.
title: Exact six-state binary weakly acyclic three-set synchronization threshold \(7\)
